svg.title: Figure 1-1. The item boundary in the cybersecurity view (WP-C-09 §2, §4, §5, §8)
svg.desc: The WP-C-01 item boundary with the WP-C-09 TARA on it. E-01 SoC software: assets AS-05, AS-06, AS-07, AS-09, AS-14; threat scenarios TS-02 (risk 5), TS-04 (risk 5), TS-06 (risk 4), TS-08 (risk 4), TS-09 (risk 4), TS-12 (risk 4), TS-14 (risk 5); entered by AP-02, AP-03, AP-04, AP-08, AP-12, AP-14. E-02 ML models: assets AS-08; threat scenarios TS-09 (risk 4), TS-10 (risk 4); entered by AP-09. E-03 panda safety MCU: assets AS-02, AS-03, AS-04; threat scenarios TS-02 (risk 5), TS-03 (risk 5), TS-05 (risk 4); entered by AP-05. E-04 storage, cameras, key: assets AS-11, AS-12, AS-13; threat scenarios TS-07 (risk 4), TS-11 (risk 5), TS-13 (risk 3); entered by AP-11. E-05 harness and relay: assets AS-15; threat scenarios TS-01 (risk 4), TS-14 (risk 5); entered by none. Vehicle CAN · Toyota ECUs: assets AS-01; threat scenarios TS-01 (risk 4), TS-14 (risk 5); entered by AP-01. comma.ai back end: assets AS-10; threat scenarios TS-07 (risk 4); entered by AP-07, AP-13. Code and supply chain: assets AS-16; threat scenarios TS-10 (risk 4); entered by AP-06, AP-10.

Ratings reflect the baseline as shipped and credit no control that does not exist yet; treatments in the reference build are not re-rated (OI-5). Where each asset and entry point is drawn is an analyst input in fig_c09_boundary.py.

g.text: Terms: AGNOS the comma device's operating system · AP-nn attack path (TARA §5); in WP-S-03 and on the TSC page, an architectural principle (WP-S-03 §2) · AS-nn asset (TARA §2) · CAN controller area network: the

vehicle's data bus · DM driver monitoring · E-nn element of the item (WP-C-01 §3.1), E-01…E-06 · ECU electronic control unit · FW firmware · IF-nn interface of the item (WP-C-01 §3.4) · IPC inter-process

communication · JWT JSON web token (the device's login token to the back end) · LD-SDA LionDriver Supervised Driving Assistance, the item · LFS Git Large File Storage (where the model files live) · MCU

microcontroller: the panda safety processor (STM32H7) · ML machine learning · OBD-II on-board diagnostics port · OI-nn open item of the document it appears in · PCS pre-collision system: Toyota's stock collision

warning and braking · QM quality managed: no ASIL; ordinary quality processes suffice · RPC remote procedure call · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · SPI serial

peripheral interface (the link between SoC and MCU) · SSH secure shell (remote login) · TARA threat analysis and risk assessment (ISO/SAE 21434) · TS-nn threat scenario (TARA §4) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04;
the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
